## August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 320)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio and Canadian syndication, four classic late-night monologues by Jean Shepherd on WOR New York exploring Chicago childhoods, high-society fads, and summer fishing (1960–1973), Sergeant Blair tracking fur smugglers in the Yukon on *Blair of the Mounties* (1935), and national debates on mid-century American literature and censorship on *America's Town Meeting of the Air* (1935–1973):
